label: a_sch_room02_eve03
text: People who are really good at drawing can make\npictures that look as realistic as photos...\c\nBut then why not just use your camera app?

label: a_sch_room02_eve04
text:
A great drawing or painting can show off some
amazing techniques that no photo could!\c
And vice versa—a great photo can do things a
drawing or painting can’t!

label: a_sch_room02_eve05
text: What a fine sculpture... Even Pokémon must be\nenvious of its beauty!

label: a_sch_room02_ni04
text: Flabébé come in all kinds of different colors, but\nI like the red ones the best!

label: a_sch_room02_ni08
text: I feel a kind of softness from this statue, almost\nas if it truly were alive...\c\nWhat a mystifying piece.
